name: Offline Protocol
tagline: Find Offline Protocol SDK packages, integration guides and project scaffolds
description:
Runs the Offline Protocol developer MCP server locally from the published @offline-protocol/cli npm package. Cline can list and compare Offline Protocol packages, search workflows, examples and skills, resolve compatible packages, generate an architecture, preview a scaffold, and scaffold or integrate packages into a project on your machine.

No account or API key is needed for local mode. The server provides package and integration guidance only: it does not discover nearby devices or operate device radios. Requires Node.js 18 or later; the first launch downloads the CLI through npx.

install.notes: Local mode needs no credentials. For the hosted endpoint instead, install with: cline mcp install offline-protocol-hosted --transport http https://mcp.offlineprotocol.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <application API key>" --header "x-app-id: <application id>". Hosted mode does not include scaffold_project, integrate_packages or init_project.
